color.note: Direction: Pre-Party (chosen, refined). Two hues do the work: plum (ground and ink) and marigold (the one loud colour). Pink is a small landing-only accent; mint is only for success. Landing is dark; the tools are light by default, with a dark option.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Landing is near-black plum, never pure black; tools are warm cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, product rows, form panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, hovered cards, skeleton bones, notices.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, steppers, unselected chips and choice cards. 3:1 on bg and surface in every theme.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary facts (ml, brand, helper text) on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, one per view. Marigold on the dark themes, plum ink on the light tools theme.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and ghost buttons on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Marigold in every theme: selected chips, stage progress, the stepper once a product is added, the sticker. The brand's constant.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight.

tokens.name: highlight-quiet
tokens.usage: Selected choice-card fill. Text on it stays text.

tokens.name: city
tokens.usage: Pink, the small Jaipur nod. LANDING ONLY, at most once per screen (the For venues block, the arch frame). The tool themes alias it to accent-text.

tokens.name: on-city
tokens.usage: Text on a city fill.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The plan summary bar and cook-mode chrome. Plum in every theme, so the night shows up even in the light tools.

tokens.name: on-bar
tokens.usage: Text on bar.

tokens.name: on-bar-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bar.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Within budget, You're on the list, Ready to make. Always with ✓ and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Guests changed, Pack size changed, One ingredient away. Always with ! and a word.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Field errors, Over budget, Temporarily unavailable. Always with ! and a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring outside a 2px bg gap, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Desktop hero only. Three to five words.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Mobile hero; tool titles on desktop.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section titles, tool titles on mobile, recipe names.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Book clubs and tables in Jaipur, pay upfront, walk in with a pass.
styles.usage: The one line under the hero; cook-mode steps (22px there).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Alcohol only. Mixers, water, ice and food aren't included.
styles.usage: Default copy. Never smaller in the tools.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Meta and helper text. Never for anything needed to continue.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Stock imagery; not listed Jaipur venues
styles.usage: Photo credit, price-checked date, legal lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, stepper parts, inline meta.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside cards, title to meta.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards and form fields; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop. Space does the separating; no dividers between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, thumbnails, skeleton bones.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, steppers, choice cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, colour blocks, the pass.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the sticker, the stage bar, and the top of the arch frame.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control.

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions and full-width mobile buttons.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Landing content width at 1440.

tokens.name: tool-max
tokens.usage: Tool content width.

tokens.name: summary-bar-h
tokens.usage: Plan summary bar on mobile; reserve as bottom padding.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the summary bar only.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Centred dialogs on tablet and desktop.
